note: 77 original IDs/parameters preserved. Q02.8 DELETE USING becomes MariaDB joined DELETE. INSERT RETURNING is checked on this MariaDB target, not claimed portable to Oracle MySQL.

rows.sql:
SELECT unit_id
FROM property_unit
WHERE project_name = :project_name
  AND house_no = :house_no;

SELECT unit_id, project_name, house_no, unit_type
FROM property_unit
WHERE status = 'IN_QC'
ORDER BY created_at;

SELECT round_id, status
FROM inspection_round
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND round_type = 'QC_INTERNAL'
  AND status <> 'CLOSED';

SELECT defect_id, category, location_pin, description, status
FROM defect
WHERE round_id = :round_id
ORDER BY created_at;

INSERT INTO defect (round_id, category, location_pin, description,
                    status, reported_by_type, reported_by_employee)
VALUES (:round_id, :category, :location_pin, :description,
        'WAITING_ASSIGN', 'INSPECTOR', :inspector_id)
RETURNING defect_id;

UPDATE defect
SET category = :category,
    location_pin = :location_pin,
    description = :description
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND status = 'WAITING_ASSIGN';

DELETE f FROM file f JOIN defect d ON f.defect_id = d.defect_id
WHERE f.defect_id = d.defect_id
  AND f.file_id = :file_id
  AND f.file_usage = 'BEFORE_FIX'
  AND d.status = 'WAITING_ASSIGN';

SELECT d.defect_id, u.project_name, u.house_no, d.category,
       d.location_pin, d.description, d.target_date
FROM defect d
JOIN inspection_round r ON r.round_id = d.round_id
JOIN property_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id
JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = :technician_id
WHERE d.status = 'WAITING_ASSIGN'
  AND (e.craft_category IS NULL OR d.category = e.craft_category)
ORDER BY d.created_at;

SELECT file_id, file_url
FROM file
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND file_usage = 'BEFORE_FIX';

UPDATE defect
SET technician_id = :technician_id,
    status = 'ASSIGNED',
    assigned_date = now()
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND status = 'WAITING_ASSIGN';

SELECT defect_id, category, location_pin, description,
       status, rework_count, target_date
FROM defect
WHERE technician_id = :technician_id
  AND status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'REWORK')
ORDER BY assigned_date;

SELECT count(*) AS after_photo_count
FROM file f
JOIN defect d ON d.defect_id = f.defect_id
WHERE f.defect_id = :defect_id
  AND f.file_usage = 'AFTER_FIX'
  AND f.uploaded_at > COALESCE(d.completed_date, '-infinity');

UPDATE defect
SET status = 'FIXED',
    completed_date = now()
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND technician_id = :technician_id
  AND status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'REWORK');

SELECT d.defect_id, r.unit_id, d.category, d.location_pin,
       d.description, d.rework_count, d.completed_date
FROM defect d
JOIN inspection_round r ON r.round_id = d.round_id
WHERE r.round_type = 'QC_INTERNAL'
  AND r.status = 'OPEN'
  AND d.status = 'FIXED'
ORDER BY d.completed_date;

SELECT file_id, file_usage, file_url
FROM file
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND file_usage IN ('BEFORE_FIX', 'AFTER_FIX')
ORDER BY file_usage, uploaded_at;

UPDATE defect
SET status = 'VERIFIED',
    verified_by = :inspector_id,
    verified_at = now()
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND status = 'FIXED';

UPDATE defect
SET status = 'REWORK',
    rework_count = rework_count + 1
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND status = 'FIXED';

SELECT r.round_id, r.unit_id, r.started_at
FROM inspection_round r
WHERE r.round_type = 'QC_INTERNAL'
  AND r.status = 'OPEN'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM defect d
                  WHERE d.round_id = r.round_id
                    AND d.status <> 'VERIFIED');

UPDATE inspection_round
SET recheck_date = :recheck_date,
    recheck_result = NULL,
    status = 'RECHECK_SCHEDULED'
WHERE round_id = :round_id
  AND status = 'OPEN'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM defect
                  WHERE round_id = :round_id
                    AND status <> 'VERIFIED');

UPDATE inspection_round
SET recheck_result = :recheck_result
WHERE round_id = :round_id
  AND status = 'RECHECK_SCHEDULED';

INSERT INTO defect (round_id, category, location_pin, description,
                    status, reported_by_type, reported_by_employee)
VALUES (:round_id, :category, :location_pin, :description,
        'WAITING_ASSIGN', 'INSPECTOR', :inspector_id)
RETURNING defect_id;

UPDATE inspection_round
SET status = 'OPEN',
    recheck_result = NULL,
    recheck_date = NULL
WHERE round_id = :round_id
  AND status = 'RECHECK_SCHEDULED'
  AND recheck_result = 'DEFECT_FOUND';

SELECT r.round_id, r.unit_id, r.inspector_id, r.recheck_date
FROM inspection_round r
WHERE r.round_type = 'QC_INTERNAL'
  AND r.status = 'RECHECK_SCHEDULED'
  AND r.recheck_result = 'NO_DEFECT'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM defect d
                  WHERE d.round_id = r.round_id
                    AND d.status <> 'VERIFIED');

SELECT employee_id, full_name
FROM employee
WHERE role = 'INSPECTOR'
  AND is_active = TRUE
  AND employee_id <> :inspector_id
ORDER BY full_name;

UPDATE inspection_round
SET status = 'CLOSED',
    co_inspector_id = :co_inspector_id,
    is_single_certify = :is_single_certify,
    closed_at = now()
WHERE round_id = :round_id
  AND status = 'RECHECK_SCHEDULED'
  AND recheck_result = 'NO_DEFECT';

SELECT u.unit_id, u.project_name, u.house_no, r.round_id, r.closed_at
FROM property_unit u
JOIN inspection_round r ON r.unit_id = u.unit_id
WHERE u.status = 'IN_QC'
  AND r.round_type = 'QC_INTERNAL'
  AND r.status = 'CLOSED'
ORDER BY r.closed_at;

UPDATE property_unit
SET status = 'READY_TO_SELL'
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND status = 'IN_QC'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inspection_round r
              WHERE r.unit_id = :unit_id
                AND r.round_type = 'QC_INTERNAL'
                AND r.status = 'CLOSED');

SELECT unit_id, project_name, house_no, unit_type
FROM property_unit
WHERE status = 'READY_TO_SELL'
ORDER BY project_name, house_no;

UPDATE property_unit
SET customer_id = :customer_id,
    status = 'CONTRACTED'
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND status = 'READY_TO_SELL';

SELECT l.link_id, l.unit_id, l.customer_id,
       u.project_name, u.house_no, u.status
FROM access_link l
JOIN property_unit u ON u.unit_id = l.unit_id
WHERE l.token = :token
  AND l.expires_at > now();

UPDATE property_unit
SET status = 'READY_HANDOVER'
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND status = 'CONTRACTED';

SELECT l.unit_id, l.customer_id,
       u.project_name, u.house_no, u.status
FROM access_link l
JOIN property_unit u ON u.unit_id = l.unit_id
WHERE l.token = :token
  AND l.expires_at > now()
  AND u.status = 'CONTRACTED';

UPDATE property_unit
SET status = 'WAITING_INSPECTION'
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND status = 'CONTRACTED';

SELECT u.unit_id, u.project_name, u.house_no,
       c.customer_id, c.full_name, c.phone_number
FROM property_unit u
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = u.customer_id
WHERE c.id_card_no = :id_card_no
  AND u.status = 'CONTRACTED';

UPDATE property_unit
SET status = 'WAITING_INSPECTION'
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND status = 'CONTRACTED';

SELECT request_id, unit_id, customer_id, preferred_date, appointment
FROM inspection_request
WHERE status = 'SUBMITTED'
ORDER BY preferred_date;

UPDATE inspection_request
SET appointment = :appointment
WHERE request_id = :request_id
  AND status = 'SUBMITTED';

UPDATE inspection_request
SET arrival = now(),
    status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
WHERE request_id = :request_id
  AND status = 'SUBMITTED';

UPDATE property_unit
SET status = 'IN_INSPECTION'
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND status = 'WAITING_INSPECTION';

SELECT r.round_id, l.unit_id
FROM access_link l
JOIN inspection_round r ON r.unit_id = l.unit_id
WHERE l.token = :token
  AND l.expires_at > now()
  AND r.round_type = 'CUSTOMER_HANDOVER'
  AND r.status = 'OPEN';

SELECT defect_id, round_id, location_pin, description, reported_by_type, created_at
FROM defect
WHERE status = 'NEW'
ORDER BY created_at;

SELECT file_id, file_url
FROM file
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND file_usage = 'BEFORE_FIX';

UPDATE defect
SET category = :category,
    target_date = :target_date,
    assigned_by = :employee_id,
    status = 'WAITING_ASSIGN'
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND status = 'NEW';

SELECT r.round_id, r.unit_id
FROM inspection_round r
WHERE r.round_type = 'CUSTOMER_HANDOVER'
  AND r.status = 'OPEN'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM defect d WHERE d.round_id = r.round_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM defect d
                  WHERE d.round_id = r.round_id
                    AND d.status NOT IN ('FIXED', 'VERIFIED'));

SELECT d.defect_id, d.category, d.location_pin, d.description, d.status,
       f.file_usage, f.file_url
FROM defect d
LEFT JOIN file f ON f.defect_id = d.defect_id
WHERE d.round_id = :round_id
ORDER BY d.defect_id, f.file_usage;

SELECT unit_id, customer_id
FROM access_link
WHERE token = :token
  AND expires_at > now();

SELECT r.round_id, r.request_id,
       d.defect_id, d.location_pin, d.category, d.status,
       d.target_date, d.completed_date
FROM defect d
JOIN inspection_round r ON r.round_id = d.round_id
WHERE r.unit_id = :unit_id
  AND r.round_type = 'CUSTOMER_HANDOVER'
ORDER BY d.defect_id;

SELECT file_usage, file_url
FROM file
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND file_usage IN ('BEFORE_FIX', 'AFTER_FIX')
ORDER BY file_usage, uploaded_at;

SELECT rp.report_id, rp.title, rp.created_at, f.file_url
FROM repair_report rp
JOIN file f ON f.report_id = rp.report_id
WHERE rp.round_id = :round_id
  AND f.file_usage = 'SUMMARY_PDF'
ORDER BY rp.created_at DESC, rp.report_id DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT count(*) AS not_ready
FROM defect
WHERE round_id = :round_id
  AND status NOT IN ('FIXED', 'VERIFIED');

UPDATE defect
SET status = 'VERIFIED',
    verified_at = now()
WHERE round_id = :round_id
  AND status = 'FIXED';

UPDATE inspection_request
SET accept_result = 'ACCEPTED',
    status = 'COMPLETED',
    accepted_at = now()
WHERE request_id = :request_id
  AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS';

UPDATE inspection_round
SET status = 'CLOSED',
    closed_at = now()
WHERE round_id = :round_id
  AND status = 'OPEN';

UPDATE property_unit
SET status = 'READY_HANDOVER'
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND status = 'IN_INSPECTION';

UPDATE inspection_request
SET accept_result = 'REJECTED',
    accept_reason = :accept_reason
WHERE request_id = :request_id
  AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS';

UPDATE defect
SET status = 'REWORK',
    rework_count = rework_count + 1
WHERE defect_id = :defect_id
  AND round_id = :round_id
  AND status = 'FIXED';

SELECT l.unit_id, l.customer_id, u.project_name, u.house_no, u.status
FROM access_link l
JOIN property_unit u ON u.unit_id = l.unit_id
WHERE l.token = :token
  AND l.expires_at > now()
  AND u.status = 'READY_HANDOVER';

UPDATE property_unit
SET status = 'HANDED_OVER',
    handed_over_at = now()
WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
  AND status = 'READY_HANDOVER';

SELECT employee_id, full_name, role, craft_category, password_hash
FROM employee
WHERE employee_id = :employee_id
  AND is_active = TRUE;
